newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Hyundai Motor April sales up 12.9 pct.
newsitem.headline: Hyundai Motor April sales up 12.9 pct.

text.p: Hyundai Motor Co Ltd, South Korea's largest carmaker, on Friday said sales in April totalled 123,476 vehicles, up 12.9 percent from 109,354 a year earlier.
Exports were 57,980 against 44,830 a year earlier and domestic sales 65,496 units against 64,524, a statement said.
A Hyundai spokesman said exports improved in April due to the company's efforts to strengthen after-sales services and diversify markets.
"Exports to Europe and Australia were especially good," he said. "Our sales focus shifted to exports because of the slowing domestic market.
Recent introduction of new models by the nation's third-ranked Daewoo Motor Co also hurt Hyundai's domestic sales.
